scope: Twelve new confirmation mechanism probes created after choosing the simpler Agent from pilot-v3 and mechanism-v1. Primary candidate is adaptive_no_feedback: numerical raw conflict selects windows, local VLM sees images only. Numeric prompt arm remains an ablation, not a selectable default. Controlled synthetic mechanism recovery; no expert observable reference or field claim.
stage_policy: Same train24/validation12 calibrated models and stage head as motion-probe-v2; all visual activity arms use the same XGBoost head.
primary_metrics: Activity P/R/F1, event IoU0.3/0.5, weak recovery, boundary error, coverage, failures, call/token costs
secondary_metrics: A/S/D end-to-end macroF1, false acceleration, native VLM stage supplement
freeze: No candidate switch, parameter selection or repeat selection using these confirmation scores. Fixed pure-image observation and numeric-text ablation both retained regardless of outcome. Existing sealed background test remains untouched.
